name: Problem Matcher wrapper (linter errors as annotations even for fork PRs)
description: Invoke linters, detect errors/warnings, show them as annotations. Supports PRs from forks, unlike other Actions.

linters.description: Comma or whitespace separated list of Problem Matchers to add/remove. For example, "flake8, mypy".

action.description: To just "add" or "remove" Problem Matchers instead of wrapping a command, specify "add" or "remove" here.
